Issuer._comment: Url must match deploy/keycloak/import/mcpinterop-realm.json's identityProviders 'issuer' - Keycloak fetches it server-to-server, where 'localhost' means the Keycloak container itself, not this machine (same client.dev.internal workaround the CIMD leg's Client already uses - see docs/keycloak-setup.md's Podman-on-Windows section; requires ./deploy/keycloak/setup.sh to have written the extra_hosts override). IdentityProviderAuthority is the OpenID Provider whose ID tokens /token accepts as subject_token - Issuer fetches its discovery document/JWKS to validate them, which stays 'localhost' since Client calls /token directly from this same host, not from inside a container. ResourceAuthority is the Third-party OAuth AS this Issuer mints ID-JAGs for (the aud claim) - this repo's own setup points both settings at the same Keycloak realm, but they're independent: an implementer with a separate OpenID Provider and OAuth AS sets each accordingly (see docs/architecture.md). RequireHttpsMetadata is false only because IdentityProviderAuthority is plain http:// for local dev - never set false for anything reachable off this machine. TrustedClientIds must include whatever client_id Client's Ema:ResourceClientId sends (see Client's appsettings.json) - /token rejects any other client_id before it mints a token. Signing is RSA, generated fresh in-memory each run (see Endpoints.cs) - no SigningKey setting needed.
